title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero for the first part. Draw the first face using two loops. In the first loop, draw a rectangle starting from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0625, 0.0), then to (0.0625, 0.0417), to (0.0, 0.0417), and back to the origin. In the second loop, draw a smaller rectangle inside the first one, starting from (0.0033, 0.0033) to (0.0592, 0.0033), then to (0.0592, 0.0383), to (0.0033, 0.0383), and back to the starting point. Apply a sketch scale of 0.0625 to the entire sketch. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. This process will create a new solid body with a length of 0.0625, a width of 0.0417, and a height of 0.75.

For the second part, create another coordinate system with Euler angles set to [0.0, 0.0, -90.0] and a translation vector of [0.0267, 0.0, 0.2871]. Draw the first face using a single loop, creating a circle centered at (0.0046, 0.0046) with a radius of 0.0046. Draw the second face using another single loop, creating a circle centered at (0.0046, 0.2546) with the same radius. Apply a sketch scale of 0.2592 to the entire sketch. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using the specified Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0417 units in the opposite direction of the normal. This operation will cut or remove material from the existing body, resulting in a cylindrical protrusion with a hole. The dimensions of this part are a length of 0.0092, a width of 0.2592, and a height of 0.0417.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part (cylinder with a rectangular cross-section)
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0.0625, 0)
    .lineTo(0.0625, 0.0417)
    .lineTo(0, 0.0417)
    .close()
    .moveTo(0.0033, 0.0033)
    .lineTo(0.0592, 0.0033)
    .lineTo(0.0592, 0.0383)
    .lineTo(0.0033, 0.0383)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.75)
)

# Create the second part (cylindrical hole)
hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0046, 0.0046)
    .circle(0.0046)
    .moveTo(0.0046, 0.2546)
    .circle(0.0046)
    .extrude(-0.0417, combine=False)
)

# Translate and rotate the hole to the correct position
hole = hole.translate((0.0267, 0, 0.2871)).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)

# Combine the cylinder and the hole
r = cylinder.cut(hole)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer and inner loops of the sketch
outer_loop = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.0625, 0.0),
    (0.0625, 0.0417),
    (0.0, 0.0417),
    (0.0, 0.0)
]

inner_loop = [
    (0.0034, 0.0034),
    (0.0591, 0.0034),
    (0.0591, 0.0383),
    (0.0034, 0.0383),
    (0.0034, 0.0034)
]

# Create the sketch with the outer and inner loops
r = r.polyline(outer_loop).close().polyline(inner_loop).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.75)

import cadquery as cq

# Outer dimensions
outer_x = 0.0625
outer_y = 0.0417
height = 0.7500

# Wall thickness
t = 0.0100

# Create outer rectangle and cut inner rectangle to make a hollow tube
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(outer_x, outer_y)
    .rect(outer_x - 2 * t, outer_y - 2 * t)
    .extrude(height)
)
